title: BET Awards 2026: Here’s How to Watch the Ceremony Live Online for Free
summary: Hosted by Druski, the 26th annual BET Awards are on Sunday (June 28) — with performances from Cardi B, Doechii, Nas and others.
contentText:

“Culture’s biggest night” is back. The 2026 BET Awards return to Los Angeles on Sunday (June 28), with Druski set to host this year’s awards ceremony.

Cardi B leads the nominees list with six nominations. Kendrick Lamar and Mariah the Scientist follow with five nods each, while Doechii, Doja Cat, Clipse, Teyana Taylor, Olivia Dean and Latto all have four nods each. Meanwhile, Ms. Lauryn Hill will be honored with the Living Legend Icon Award , which is presented to industry pioneers who have “mastered their craft and never let go of the culture.”

How to Watch 2026 BET Awards Live Online, At a Glance:

- Date: June 28

- Network: BET, as well as MTV, VH1, CMT, Comedy Central, Paramount Network, Nickelodeon, TV Land, POP, LOGO

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Paramount+ , Philo , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , Fubo

Watch 2026 BET Awards on DirecTV

Who’s Performing During the 2026 BET Awards?

There’s a number of live performances by famous recording artists throughout the BET Awards, including Cardi B, Doechii, Nas, RAYE, The War and Treaty, T.I. and others. Check out a complete list of performers and presenters here .

How to Watch the 2026 BET Awards Online

The BET Awards will take place at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles, Calif., on Sunday (June 28) at 8 p.m. ET/PT on BET . If you don’t have cable, you can still watch the awards ceremony live online with a free trial from DirecTV , Philo , Hulu + Live TV and Fubo .

The plan features more than 200 other channels, including MTV, VH1, CMT, Comedy Central, Paramount Network, Nickelodeon, TV Land, POP and LOGO. Fubo comes with a five-day free trial , so you can try out the service before you commit month-to-month.
